subject: BridgeAI — post-demo unit econ & model allocation
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@bridgeai.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom@bridgeai.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, Apr 9, 2028 at 3:12 PM PDT
Subject: BridgeAI — post-demo unit econ & model allocation

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning — appreciated the clear signal on where BridgeAI is headed. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned on cost assumptions and the model mix you asked us to qualify.

High-level call notes:
- Expected steady-state traffic: ~120M total tokens / month (chat + system tokens).
- Near-term pilot (60 days): ramp to ~40–60M tokens / month.
- Target blended unit goal you mentioned: $800–$1,200 per 1M tokens (you said budget flexibility depends on quality + latency).

Initial Redwood qualification (baseline assumptions):
- Model roles and proposed splits (pilot / steady-state):
  - Chat (LLM generation, primary UI): 70% / 70%
  - Embeddings (semantic search / vector updates): 20% / 20%
  - Rerank (relevance scoring on top-k): 10% / 10%
- Unit economics (ballpark):
  - Chat (gpt-like open model family): ~$1,100 per 1M tokens
  - Embeddings (dense vectors, batched): ~$300 per 1M tokens (note: charged per embedding unit; converted here for parity)
  - Rerank (small encoder, high qps): ~$450 per 1M tokens (mostly inference cost + small overhead)
- Blended example (120M tokens): weighted blended ~= $880 / 1M tokens (this is illustrative and sensitive to exact model variant and batching).

Attachments: BridgeAI_Estimates.xlsx (simple workbook with per-model sheets: volumes, blended calc, optional reserved vs on-demand pricing).

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the 120M tokens / mo estimate or share a 3-month ramp profile?
2) You mentioned embeddings-heavy search for the recommendations product — if embeddings are closer to 30% of volume that changes blended price materially. Please confirm if embeddings will be >20%.
3) Who is the procurement contact we should route commercial terms and PO cadence to?
4) We can carve a pilot price to hit ~ $900 / 1M tokens if you can commit to a 3-month Reserved window. Shall I model that in the workbook?

If helpful I can send a variant workbook that models: (A) on-demand pricing, (B) 3-month reserved with volume bands, (C) dedicated reserved capacity for low-latency.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a revised sheet after your replies.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: BridgeAI_Estimates.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@bridgeai.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom@bridgeai.com>
Date: Mon, Apr 9, 2028 at 8:03 PM EDT
Subject: Re: BridgeAI — post-demo unit econ & model allocation

Thanks, Aditya — helpful summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side (quoting your ask inline):

> Can you confirm the 120M tokens / mo estimate or share a 3-month ramp profile?
We’re estimating 100–130M tokens steady-state; pilot will likely be 50M in month 1, 80M in month 2, 110M month 3. I’ve attached the internal traffic spreadsheet for context (not as polished).

> embeddings >20%?
For our recommendations product we expect embeddings generation + periodic vector updates to be heavier than the UI chat usage. Realistically embeddings could be 25–35% of total tokens during steady-state depending on vector refresh cadence.

> procurement contact?
Looping in procurement at procurement@bridgeai.com — Tom will be the PO owner.

Also two asks:
- Can you break out unit estimates by model variant? For embeddings we use small and medium encoders and will need per-variant $/1M so we can justify mixing.
- If you can show a reserved vs on-demand blended that hits our upper budget target (~$1,200 / 1M) vs a targeted discounted band (~$900 / 1M) that would be great.

On timing: we’ll plan a short follow-up with engineering next Tue to validate latency SLOs.

Best,
Samantha
Head of Product
BridgeAI

Date: Mon, Apr 9, 2028 at 6:05 PM PDT
Subject: Fwd: BridgeAI — post-demo unit econ & model allocation (internal note)

Quick internal take after Samantha’s reply — copying the key asks and my recommended tactics: 

- Samantha confirms ramp (50/80/110M) and embeddings 25–35% steady-state. That pushes our blended up if we keep chat-heavy models.
- Recommend we prepare two alternative allocations for the workbook:
  1) Conservative (quality-first): Chat 60%, Embeddings 30%, Rerank 10% — aim blended target $950 / 1M via modest reserved discount on chat models.
  2) Cost-first (if procurement pushes): Chat 55%, Embeddings 35%, Rerank 10% — requires larger reserved commitment or model quantization to reach ~$800 / 1M.

Notes for Aditya / Marissa:
- We should produce per-variant unit $/1M (small/medium/large variants for chat & embeddings) and a blended table that updates when embeddings % changes. Priyom can make the workbook change quickly.
- Suggested sales play: offer a 3-month reserved pilot band that guarantees latency SLOs + a 10–15% blended discount vs on-demand. If they want lower price we push for 6-month reserved.

Relevant links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/BRG-2028-47  |  Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/bridgeai-qual

—Priyom

Date: Tue, Apr 10, 2028 at 9:20 AM PDT
Subject: Re: BridgeAI — post-demo unit econ & model allocation (updated workbook + next steps)

Samantha / Tom — thanks for the rapid reply and for looping procurement. Per Priyom’s suggestion I’ve attached a revised workbook (BridgeAI_Estimates_v2.xlsx) that includes:
- Per-variant $/1M estimates (small/medium/large) for chat and embeddings.
- Two allocation scenarios (Conservative quality-first and Cost-first aggressive).
- Blended rows that recalc automatically when you change the embeddings % or total token volume.

Quick summary (rounded) from the workbook for steady-state (120M tokens):
- Scenario A (Conservative — Chat 60 / Embeddings 30 / Rerank 10): blended ~ $940 / 1M tokens
- Scenario B (Cost-first — Chat 55 / Embeddings 35 / Rerank 10): blended ~ $820 / 1M tokens

Per-variant unit examples (these are assumptions to be validated in a follow-up):
- Chat large variant: $1,300 / 1M tokens
- Chat medium variant: $900 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings small encoder: $220 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings medium encoder: $380 / 1M tokens
- Rerank encoder: $450 / 1M tokens

Pilot offer we propose:
- 3-month reserved pilot (volume band aligned to your ramp) with a blended target of ~$900 / 1M tokens and guaranteed latency SLO for chat endpoints. If you commit to 6 months we can push the blended toward ~$800 / 1M.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Procurement: Tom / procurement@bridgeai.com — confirm PO cadence (monthly vs quarterly) and any contract terms we should model.
2) Engineering sync: schedule Tue follow-up to validate latency SLOs and run a short perf test (Aditya can host an end-to-end perf run).
3) Aditya will send a short version of the workbook highlighting the two scenarios for your execs.

I’ll drop a DocuSign link for the pilot SOW once procurement confirms cadence (link below).

DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/BRG-2028-47

Thanks — I’ll be standing by for PO contact + preferred cadence and will follow up with a one-page executive summary.

Best,
Aditya Rao
